items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: And we rehearsed her music and played, you know, played in the dance part.

ctx.x: So they wanted to get an aug--, you know, get an augmented--augmented band--so we can play arrangements and stuff. So I got guys from the University of Miami--white boys-- that could read good. I could read pretty fair, you know, I wasn't a good reader. But I could read pretty fair, you know what I mean. And we rehearsed her music and played, you know, played in the dance part. See, the Harlem Square had a big dance hall in the back and outside, I mean in the front, was a big lounge.
